exposure: Birth intervention (induction, instrumental birth, caesarean section)
Birth intervention (induction, instrumental birth, cesarean section)
outcome: Characteristics of women and babies admitted to RPS
cohort: All women giving birth and babies born in New South Wales, Australia between 2000 and 2012
finding: Women who accessed residential parenting services in the first year after birth were more likely to be older, give birth in the private sector, have higher birth intervention rates, and were less likely to smoke compared to women who did not access these services.
mod_finding: There was an increase in the number of women admitted to RPS who had instrumental births between 2000 and 2012, despite overall rates remaining stable.
